universe.rule: Aggregate non-option SH common-stock rows by CUSIP; rank stated value descending, CUSIP breaks ties; first 10, fixed before prices are collected. No future survivor, return, fundamental coverage or action filter.
universe.scope: Historical ARK disclosed seed cohort, not all US stocks, not ARKK's daily portfolio or fund performance. Preserve all later historical disclosure rows, including disappeared securities.

fundamentals: US-GAAP annual 10-K or 10-K/A facts joined to the exact accession and SEC acceptance timestamp. Same report end; duration 330-380 days; use only filing accepted by decision close plus 1 hour. Amendments take effect only after their own availability. Annual age <=550 days. Missing/ambiguous fields unavailable, never zero-filled. GrossProfit/Assets or same-accession Revenues minus CostOfRevenue divided by Assets. No IFRS-to-GAAP substitution.
events: Capture 8-K items and acceptance time as filing events. Item 2.02 is not certified first public earnings-release time. No PEAD/surprise result without actual release and contemporaneous expectation data.
rebalance: Actual exchange month-end close determines following session target. Equal baseline 0.8/10. Momentum: prior months 2-12 gross total return, top3 positive scores, each 0.8/3; missing/nonpositive slots cash. Profitability: top3 positive GP/assets, each 0.8/3; unavailable slots cash. Blend: half of each fixed book, netted before integer cash execution. Fixed ranks, no fitted weights or parameter search.
execution: Reuse v2 continuous native USD cash account: next actual open, integer shares, adverse 5/15bps, dated statutory fees, minimum commission, three exchange-session sale-cash lock, prior20 volume participation cap, ex-date receivables. No leverage/short or historical fabricated bars. Any unhandled split/delisting/spin-off blocks entire account, never silently drops a seed member.
paper_scope: Independent mathematical long-only adaptations of French momentum and Novy-Marx profitability on a narrow institution-selected cohort, not reproduction of original market-wide long-short portfolios or private ARK methods.
history_role: Retrospective diagnostic; freeze before this run's returns, but historical period has been seen in other studies. Independent forward OOS false.
